name: io.github.tonyyang0504/qihoo_360_ads-mcp
description: 360 点睛营销平台 360 Ads (ads): me, get_report, update_budget, pause_resume. Every tool maps to a document

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_QIHOO_360_ADS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: ApiKey e-mailed after the open.e.360.cn developer application is approved; sent as the `apiKey` HTTP header on every call.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_QIHOO_360_ADS_ENCRYPTED_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: clientLogin `passwd`: AES-CBC(MD5(password)) with key = first 16 characters of the ApiSecret and IV = last 16, as 64 lowercase hex characters (身份认证: '秘钥是apiSecret 的前16位，向量是后16位'). It is a fixed value, so compute it once with 360's official 'openAPI登录接口AES调试工具' or its code samples; the password itself is never needed. Five wrong logins lock the account until the next day.
